notes: Entries are ordered by documented development chronology, not numeric label. Missing versions and unknown dates are not invented. Local evidence is stripped before publication. 0.79.2 and 0.79.5 are current uncommitted working-tree campaigns at this review, not new Git releases. Analyzer/MCP have independent version domains.

entries.title: Modify navigation and normal library sizing.
entries.note: Max 2027 UI correction; configured scaling and native-message qualification remain distinct from physical monitor and production-scene acceptance.

changes.text: Lazy Modify sections bind their existing background wheel and vertical drag handler; buttons, numeric controls and list resize grips retain their input.
Max default UI scale now produces normal-size library text and thumbnails; parent-DPI changes re-arrange the managed library.
Navigation checks measure real input movement and preserve pending Manual settings, Undo, placement and work/upload counters.

entries.title: Collection gallery, portable recipes and installer.
entries.note: Max 2027 development delivery, qualified for its declared static-asset subset. Normal-profile installation, production renderer/input and general heavy-session acceptance remain separate.

changes.text: Collection tree, large thumbnails, explicit viewport capture, revisioned saves and selective style apply.

Identical settings skip scene work; discarded imported setups and departed scenes release retained calculation caches.

entries.title: Regular planting grids and two more presets.
entries.note: Scoped Max 2027 qualification and MZP; not installed. Physical DPI, heavy heap-pressure Undo and the remaining program/EXE remain open.

changes.text: Rectangular, Staggered and Hexagonal positions with physical spacing, fixed world origin/heading and stable jitter, independent of source assignment.
Cached projection and complete 64-bit cell identities integrate masks, Paint, Bands, orientation, Edit and spacing. Inactive Count/Density/refill animation does no grid work.
Orchard and hexagonal hillside recipes with real result thumbnails and editable scenes; six examples are bundled. Complete/numeric presets use formats 4/3 with strict earlier reads.

entries.title: Explicit copy and recipe variation.
entries.note: Scoped Max 2027 qualification and MZP; not installed. Heavy heap-pressure Undo remains unresolved. Remaining program and EXE stay open.

changes.text: Same/New layer copies, Saved/New recipe imports and explicit numeric Amount seed policies.
Independent ownership with preserved receiver random inputs, complete supported Paint copying and rollback after late import failures.
Format-3 recipes with strict preceding-format reads; passive choices preserve calculation, preparation and upload counters.

entries.title: Direction, target aiming and angular normal blending.
entries.note: Scoped Max 2027 qualification and MZP; no artist installation. Remaining program and EXE stay open.

changes.text: World direction and Look at target modes, explicit source forward axes and 0â€“100% geometric-normal blending.
Direction-only changes reuse candidates and copied normals. Relevant animation updates orientation; idle, inactive targets and target geometry changes avoid scatter work.
Format-2 recipes and numeric Transform presets preserve orientation, with strict neutral-default reads of the preceding format-1 examples.

entries.title: Searchable recipes, stored thumbnails and four planting examples.
entries.note: Scoped Max 2027 qualification; MZP packaged without installation. Remaining roadmap resumed; final EXE remains pending.

changes.text: Search, categories/tags, stored PNG thumbnails, clear layer/Paint/dependency summaries and owner-specific complete-save errors.
Bounded file-only scans, explicit refresh/cancellation and indexed search preserve idle scatter and upload counters.
Four procedural meadow, woodland, mountain and painted-border examples with matching Max scenes and actual-result thumbnails; user recipes remain separate.

entries.title: Faster panel opening and clearer performance diagnostics.
entries.note: Scoped Max 2027 qualification. Installer supplied without installation; Phase 6 remains paused.

changes.text: Closed sections create controls on first opening and retain them while mounted. Unchanged list rows and styling are reused; layer callbacks retain explicit owners.
Bounded opt-in stage totals, edit action IDs and passive cached setup snapshots distinguish panel work from calculation, preparation and uploads.
Narrow and scaled panels reflow controls, wrap long text, retain full page height and keep paired fields readable. Managed lists use the native Max font.

entries.title: Save and reuse complete static planting recipes, including Paint.
entries.note: Scoped Max 2027 qualification; manual installation and artist acceptance remain separate. Phase 6 stays paused.

changes.text: Multi-layer Save Everything includes native Paint coverage, holes, disabled and empty areas, curves, Bands, source roles, seeds and spacing relationships.
Reviewed scene-role substitution, fresh imported identities and transactional Add/new setup with one Undo. Compatible Paint terrain and saved units are required.

Bounded local recipe pages and metadata caching avoid placement work while browsing. Unsupported Edit/radius overrides or nonstatic controllers block complete save; asset packaging and arbitrary-terrain Paint projection remain future work.

entries.title: Plant from mesh channels and understand Paint controls.
entries.note: Separate user-selected delivery with scoped Max 2027 qualification. Phase 6 remains paused; installation and artist acceptance are separate.

changes.text: Layer-owned density from vertex colors or numbered mesh channels, with component, input range, invert and curve controls. Reads evaluated Curvature and composes with Paint.
Explicit bounded grayscale mask preview uses a cached snapshot. Channel-only edits retain Edit geometry bindings; invalid inputs retain the previous complete result.
Paint hover descriptions explain density/scale fading, edge and inner size, brush actions and area controls.

entries.title: Quiet idle and lighter panel updates.
entries.note: Performance successor to the first five phases. Max 2027 qualification is recorded separately; Phase 6 remains paused.

changes.text: A successful cached refresh clears all evaluated layers, preventing repeated work after opening panels.
An unavailable native preview gets bounded display retries without repeatedly synchronizing the scene.
Unrelated notifications use registered Scatter controllers; panel binding avoids redundant visibility and unchanged setting updates.

entries.title: Editable Paint borders through spline snapshots.
entries.note: Phase numbering corrected from 0.85.0 on 14 October 2026; original qualification receipts retain their build identities. Artist acceptance and normal installation remain separate.

changes.text: Export Paint contours and holes as an independent planar Editable Spline; import closed shapes with Replace or Add and a world-unit curve tolerance.
Bounded conversion preserves area settings, supports Undo and follows Manual/Live. Detached spline edits and deletion leave the imported snapshot unchanged.
Deleting an unrelated object no longer forces ordinary layers to rebuild; real dependency deletions still invalidate the affected result.

entries.title: Density mapping controls and sample reuse.
entries.note: Phase numbering corrected from 0.84.0 on 14 October 2026; original qualification receipts retain their build identities. Artist acceptance and normal installation remain separate.

changes.text: Select receiver UV channels 1..99 and density resolutions 64, 128, 256 or 512; defaults remain 1 and 128.
Map-only bake reuse avoids resampling unchanged textures during receiver edits and derives inversion without rebaking.
Missing, incomplete or invalid UV data names the affected receiver/channel and preserves the preceding complete planting.

entries.title: Slope and altitude eligibility.
entries.note: Phase numbering corrected from 0.83.0 on 14 October 2026; original qualification receipts retain their build identities. Artist acceptance and normal installation remain separate.

changes.text: Per-layer world-up slope and world-Z altitude limits, with independent inside fades.
Filtering preserves surviving candidate identities and transforms, reuses candidate generation and retains protected CS Edit plants.
Prepared-pool filter statistics follow the same atomic Manual/Live publication as placements.

entries.title: Reusable settings and curve presets.
entries.note: Phase numbering corrected from 0.82.0 on 14 October 2026; original qualification receipts retain their build identities. Artist acceptance and normal installation remain separate.

changes.text: Save, apply, rename and delete named population, transform, spacing and curve presets in a compact local browser.
Typed data preserves physical distances across scene units and leaves models, receivers and identities intact.
Preset Apply supports one Undo, respects Manual/Live updates and protects shared or animated controllers.
Closing a curve graph after undoing a preset does not reapply the undone curve.

entries.title: Clearer layer and calculated-result feedback.
entries.note: Committed source checkpoint with scoped Max tests; final physical artist acceptance remains pending.

changes.text: Statistics uses the selected layer name and separates accepted placements from prepared preview samples and pending updates.
Generated component callbacks are released after binding so cached-statistics actions work.
An empty preview cache for a new Manual layer is distinguished from a completed calculation.

entries.title: Reliable zero-limit Point Cloud and display-mode reuse.
entries.note: Development correction requiring matched native modules. Installed 0.81.6 packages remain separate from this candidate.

changes.text: Point Cloud requests above the preview memory allowance use a bounded sample with an explicit status, including when both artist limits are zero.
Current-publication Point Cloud, Mesh and proxy-shape snapshots are reused across display-mode switches, avoiding repeated Mesh cache allocations before garbage collection.

entries.title: Adaptive viewport limits and lighter Mesh fallback.
entries.note: User-selected development version. Requires matched native modules; scene and host acceptance are scoped separately from release certification.

changes.text: Independent navigating and idle limits for points, proxy instances and Mesh triangles, shared across visible layers. Zero means unlimited display budget.
Mesh admission uses cached boxes when geometry cannot fit the preview allowance. Emergency drawing uses bounded centre markers instead of CPU source triangles.
Camera movement switches prepared draw quotas without recalculating planting or uploading unchanged geometry. Mesh limit changes retain source geometry.

entries.title: Larger planting populations and faster source rectangles.
entries.note: User-selected development version. Schema 58 remains; matched native modules are required. Scoped tests and an actual terrace-scene workflow are recorded separately from release certification.

changes.text: Count accepts up to one million per population while retaining a shared one-million controller work limit and stable existing candidate identities.
Source rectangles open compact properties, and label updates avoid rebuilding their movement setup. Full planting settings remain on the Scatter controller.
Point preview preparation copies only bounded displayed samples, allowing larger populations without staging every placement transform.
The render bridge uses the same pivot-local source frame as native preview, correcting extra source-node scaling in Particle Flow.
Texture Density errors identify receivers missing UV channel 1 and explain how to repair the input.

entries.title: Retained preview reuse and bounded field evaluation.
entries.note: Bounded corrections preserving schema 58 and publication policy. Prepared for manual acceptance; tests and Max execution are deferred for this delivery.

changes.text: Unchanged layers can retain geometry and radius-overlay buffers across calculation publications after comparing their published display inputs.
Prepared density curves interpolate without repeatedly validating their complete sample arrays.
Spline field memory reservations include scale curves and scale-slope storage.

entries.title: Direct scale controls and clearable Band assignments.
entries.note: Bounded UI correction. Saved schema 58 and native interface 9 are unchanged; physical artist acceptance remains separate.

changes.text: Scale controls appear directly below the density curve without opening Advanced.
Band models, Points and assignment groups toggle on and off with a click, including an empty selection. Assignment edits support Undo/Redo.

entries.title: Independent Band scale curves.
entries.note: User-selected development patch label. Schema 58 requires fresh setups; prior scenes need their matching build. See local evidence for qualification limits.

changes.text: Band scale profiles: Off, Follow Density and Custom, with an independent editable size curve and preserved random Min/Max variation.
Saved scale graphs retain Band ownership through reorder, copy and reopen. Manual keeps published plants and radii until Update.

entries.title: One editing workflow. Reversible source types.
entries.note: Development source; automated checks are recorded in the implementation evidence. New installers, physical artist acceptance and publication remain pending.

changes.text: Removed the floating layer editor and Go to assigned Band navigation. Edit through the Scatter or source-container Modify panel.
Compact Pick object and Make point actions preserve source row identity, settings and Band assignments. Points use Manual radius; supported model geometry can use Auto.
Band model assignments appear below width/range and before density. Advanced Scale has adjacent Min and Max fields.

entries.title: Explicit Bands. Faithful field feedback.
entries.note: Local Max 2026/2027 development delivery with bounded validation. Heavy-scene performance, complete physical artist and renderer acceptance remain open.

changes.text: Stable Path/Band controls, Independent ranges, density curves, Rounded/Sharp corners and accepted-owner identification colors.
Selected/combined field previews, clipped boundaries and saved Auto Radius with independent XY/3D spacing metrics.
Empty Consecutive Bands reserve their intervals. Manual field feedback preserves published plants/radii and labels pending inputs.
Fresh current-schema setups only; old scene migration, placement readers and obsolete prototype paths are removed.
Models & Points hover no longer triggers a full panel layout. Layout mode switches avoid reflowing unrelated sections and rewriting unchanged controls.
Hidden Band list hosts no longer cover Clusters and Spline bands on first opening Layout.
Removed permanent help paragraphs from settings panels; controls, counts, pending states and errors remain visible. Detailed guidance remains in the website and tooltips.

entries.title: Safer recovery. Unit-aware distances.
entries.note: Source validation in Max 2026/2027; no new installer. Native Paint/Edit rescaling and physical release acceptance remain guarded or pending.

changes.text: Publication failures retain the previous complete result across native allocation and scripted installation checks.
Schema 56 stores distances in unit-aware fields and migrates the immediately preceding schema 55 while keeping multipliers dimensionless.

entries.title: More focused previews. Clearer creation.
entries.note: First panel construction and physical creation-input acceptance remain open.

changes.text: Local color edits prepare only affected layers and reuse unchanged sibling display buffers.
Failed preview staging retains the complete previous result and clears recovered sibling errors.
New controller icons appear during placement and sizing, before a plant cache exists, and return correctly after Undo.

entries.note: The reported physical Live picker disappearance remains unresolved.

changes.text: Manual layer removal and display switching keep each preview attached to its published owner.

entries.note: Cross-system-unit conversion of per-area falloff distances remains unresolved.

changes.text: Assign Point sources directly to Spline bands; replace a Point with a model while retaining its row identity.

Matching Max 2026 and Max 2027 vector-brush packages and focused button/callback checks.

Cached borders, inward/outward feathering and separate density and scale curves.

Reuse prepared receiver candidates and prepare only new or changed receivers.
